correctedState: No `prefersReducedMotion` settings key exists in the fork -- `grep -a` across the whole tree finds the identifier only inside the doc-sweep artifacts under docs/superpowers/specs/, never in source or in any config schema (packages/shared/src/config/). But the fork does honour the OS `prefers-reduced-motion` signal in three places, not one, and the Electron renderer is among them: (1) packages/ui/src/components/markdown/extensions/animated-task-item.css:156 (tiptap task-item checkbox/strike); (2) apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/CompactPanelTransition.tsx:21,47-48 via `useReducedMotion()` from motion/react, degrading the compact navigator/detail slide to a 120 ms tween; (3) apps/webui/src/login.html:189 (background drift + button hover). The real, narrower gap: honouring is piecemeal rather than app-wide -- apps/electron/src/renderer/index.css has no reduced-motion guard, so the shimmer keyframes at :1041-1088 (`animate-shimmer`, `animate-shimmer-loading`, `animate-shimmer-text`) and most Tailwind transitions run regardless. On the TUI side the doc sentence's spinner half is partly matched: apps/cli/src/index.ts exposes `--no-spinner`/`--disable-spinner` (:116-118) and suppresses the spinner when stdout is not a TTY or NO_COLOR is set (:266). Note also that Claude's `prefersReducedMotion` is a settings.json key for a terminal TUI, which has no OS motion signal to read; an Electron renderer gets that signal from Chromium for free, so the parity question here is coverage of the media query, not the presence of a settings key.
